title: Arccounting
tagline: All-in-one dashboard for private payroll, invoicing, and AI business intelligence.
description: Arc Counting helps businesses with payroll and accounts receivable in a single platform. Operators can easily pay their employees or make advances to them through smart contracts. Operators are also able to pay freelancers and see how much they owe at any given time via USDC transactions on the Arc network. When billing customers, businesses can also bill for their usage (i.e., usage fees), send B2B invoices, sell one time products, and generate checkout links via WalletConnect Pay. When employees and customers are managed through aliases and wallets, they maintain privacy until required to identify themselves. Operators can also view their treasury activity in real-time to determine current balances, obligations, and expected revenues.
how_its_made:
- Cannes2026EthGlobal/webapp : 
      Full stack Next.js application using Reown Auth with convex DB for persistence.
      Handling Payments for WalletConnect Pay,
      Storing Customers, Employees, PayChecks, Products, Handling entire infra for them
      Providing AI Agent for analyzation and operation of business data. 
-Cannes2026EthGlobal/arccounting-cre-prod : 
       Running Chainlink's CRE (Chainlink Runtime Environment) to automate private on-chain payroll execution.
       On a cron schedule, queries Convex DB for employees with due payments,                           
       submits signed reports via CRE's EVMClient to a payroll smart contract on-chain,               
       and marks each payment as settled back in Convex, all running inside a confidential compute   
  environment.
auto_summary: A Next.js and Convex business payments app uses Arc smart contracts, Chainlink CRE workflows, and WalletConnect Pay for payroll and checkout flows.
